Coram : ALTAMAS KABIR*, JASTI CHELAMESWAR
Specific performance - Agreement to sell - Payment of C earnest money - As per clause of the agreement, if permission for transfer not granted within a specific time, the vendors had the option to determine the agreement - Permission not granted - Vendor determined the the earnest money - Purchaser by a letter D telling the vendors that they were willing to purchase the property even beyond the stipulated period and telling that they accepted the earnest money under protest - Suit for specific performance of the agreement - Dismissed by trial court - Order
Decision Date : 08-08-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5787/2012 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
